# RUHVI - 24K & 22K Gold Plated Jewellery India

> RUHVI (ruhvi.in) is an Indian e-commerce brand specializing in premium 24K and 22K gold-plated, anti-tarnish, and hypoallergenic daily wear jewellery with a 6-month color guarantee.

## Brand Specifications & Features
- Base Metal: High-grade solid brass.
- Plating Options: 24K Gold Plated & 22K Gold Plated.
- Plating Protection: Electronic anti-tarnish coating (e-coating), 100% waterproof and sweat-proof.
- Skin Safety: Nickel-free, lead-free, 100% hypoallergenic safe for sensitive skin.
- Guarantee: 6-month color and shine replacement guarantee.
- Pricing & Currency: Indian Rupee (INR ₹).
- Shipping Region: All-India delivery.

## Product Collections
- 24K Gold Plated Necklaces & Chokers
- 22K Gold Plated Daily Wear Chains & Bracelets
- Anti-Tarnish Hypoallergenic Earrings & Studs
- Ethnic & Modern Traditional Jewellery Sets

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Is RUHVI gold plated jewellery anti-tarnish? Yes, all RUHVI pieces use an advanced e-coating that protects against water, sweat, and tarnish, backed by a 6-month color guarantee.
- Is RUHVI jewellery suitable for sensitive skin? Yes, our pieces are crafted on nickel-free and lead-free brass bases, making them 100% hypoallergenic.
